name: zvideo_dd_enumerate_direct3d_devices_for_record
description: zVideo_dd::EnumerateDirect3DDevicesForRecord queries Direct3D2 from the DirectDraw2 interface, enumerates D3D devices into a hardware API record, releases the temporary Direct3D2 interface, and reports whether any usable D3D drivers were accepted.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a95e0 validates the source file zvid_dd.c, the newline-prefixed ENUMERATE DRIVERS printf using entry->m_driverName, fflush(stdout), g_zVideo_pDirectDraw2->QueryInterface(IID_IDirect3D2, &g_zVideo_pD3D2), ReportError with line 0x781 and return 0 on query failure, accepted-count reset to zero before enumeration, g_zVideo_pD3D2->EnumDevices(zVideo_dd::EnumDirect3DDeviceCallback, entry), conditional release/nulling of g_zVideo_pD3D2, No useable drivers printf and return 0 when no D3D devices were accepted, and return 1 when the accepted count is nonzero.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a95e0 has no warning tags. Direct callee zVideo_dd::EnumDirect3DDeviceCallback is tier C or better, and the remaining calls are DirectDraw/Direct3D provider calls plus CRT printf/fflush.
